role: Test double conforming to HealthKitServiceProtocol: every query returns a configurable stored value or throws a configurable error, so services can be tested without HealthKit. Used by MorningProcessingServiceTests, HRVAnalysisPipelineTests, ReanalysisServiceTests, SleepBoundaryResolverTests, SessionImmutabilityTests, DemoSessionSeederTests.
toplevel: Stored-property initializers set the default canned responses (empty sleep, zero training load, nil vitals). fetchDaytimeNapMinutes is not implemented, so the protocol extension default (0) is used.

flags.text: Several configurable knobs are never set or read by any test (grep of EmuquTests for '.<name>' finds 0 hits): startObservingSleepDataCallCount, stopObservingSleepDataCallCount, authorizationRequested, healthKitHRSleepData, additionalSleepEnd/Start, hrStats, workoutInRange, sleepTrend, trainingMetrics, exportSleepError, exportSessionMetricsError; the paths through those protocol methods are only exercised with defaults.
recoveryVitalsError is declared but fetchRecoveryVitals never throws or reads it (the protocol method is non-throwing), so setting it has no effect.

The first-pass dead-knob list is incomplete: across all of EmuquTests the only mock property ever assigned is daytimeRestingHR (HRVAnalysisPipelineTests.swift:206). sleepData, sleepDataError, authorizationError, isHealthKitAvailable, heartRateSamples, heartRateSamplesError, daytimeRestingHRError, trainingLoad, vo2Max and recoveryVitals are never set, so no test drives a HealthKit error, an unavailable HealthKit, or non-empty sleep/HR/vitals data through this mock into MorningProcessingService, HRVAnalysisPipeline or ReanalysisService.
